description: This file contains the implementation of an encoder for write-ahead log (WAL) records in the etcd storage system, including functions for creating encoders, encoding records, handling frame sizes, padding, and writing data.

classes.name: encoder
classes.description: A struct that handles encoding WAL records with thread safety, CRC checksum calculation, and buffered writing.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a walpb.Record, calculates CRC, applies padding, and writes it to the underlying writer.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the buffered data to the underlying writer.

methods.name: encodeFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates the frame size and padding bytes for a given data length, ensuring 8-byte alignment.
